plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically relative to my private value. Since my value is $39, I want to maximize potential profit. A rational approach is to bid slightly below my true value - around $38.5 - which leaves room for potential profit if I win, while not overpaying. This strategy recognizes that other rational bidders will also be calculating their optimal bids.
